summary: A Codex seat now starts with its work root already trusted. Before it starts the Codex app-server, the seat's controlled launch appends a [projects."<work root>"] trust_level = "trusted" entry to the config.toml under the seat's own CODEX_HOME (else ~/.codex), only when that entry is absent. Every other entry and comment stays, a second start changes nothing, and no login, auth.json or key file is read or written. Codex therefore no longer stops a new seat at its "Do you trust this directory?" prompt.

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol or wire change. The trust entry uses the config format the existing pretrust_codex_at already wrote; it has not been exercised against a running Codex yet.

downtime.detail: No restart is needed beyond the usual daemon upgrade.

manual.detail: None. A work root already trusted in the config is left as it is.

recovery.detail: Revert the change. Trust entries already written stay, which is harmless.
